selected_evidence.requirement: Rootless containerized application serves on port 8080 without an active login session
selected_evidence.summary: The endpoint returned the expected content through node1's managed IP; the container process was owned by appsvc, port 8080 was listening and allowed through firewalld, linger was enabled, and appsvc had zero sessions.
The service was healthy before reboot and automatically returned active after reboot with its container, listener, and application content intact.

Captured healthy boot ID 717db5a2-895d-4bfb-b8a8-d4891c7b7b01, received the safe reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID 588eff87-e05d-4623-91d3-1ba7ba77e0cb, and directly verified full application recovery.

cat > /home/appsvc/.config/containers/systemd/appsvc-web.container <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'

Description=Rootless appsvc web application
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

ContainerName=appsvc-web
PublishPort=0.0.0.0:8080:80
Volume=/home/appsvc/www:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro,Z

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
